exposure: Hysteroscopic mechanical tissue removal (using 'no-touch' vaginoscopic approach) as primary treatment for Cesarean Scar Pregnancy (CSP)
outcome: Major complication rate (uterine perforation, persistent trophoblastic disease)
Differences between anatomical types of CSP (Type 1 vs. Type 2)
cohort: The study included 53 patients diagnosed with Cesarean Scar Pregnancy who underwent primary hysteroscopic resection at a tertiary care center.
finding: Primary hysteroscopic mechanical tissue removal for Cesarean Scar Pregnancy demonstrated high success (96.2%), rapid b-hCG resolution, short operative time, and a low incidence of major complications, making it an effective and safe primary treatment option.
